post.summary:
A cashier asks for the payment to be reversed, for example a dishonoured cheque (US-33, BR-306). 202: the
payment waits in `PendingReversal` and nothing can be allocated from it meanwhile. 409 when it already
waits, is reversed, or one of its allocations waits for a decision of its own.

A second person approves the reversal of the payment, and that reverses it (BR-306, BR-603, BR-606): every
allocation still applied is reversed first, then the payment, each with its mirror ledger posting, in one
transaction. The cashier who asked cannot approve: 403. The body, an optional comment, may be left out.
A second person rejects the reversal of the payment, saying why (BR-605): the payment is posted again, as it was.

A cashier asks for one allocation of the payment to be reversed (US-32, BR-305). 202: the allocation waits in
`PendingReversal`, still applied to its bill. 404 when the payment has no such allocation; 409 when it
already waits or is reversed, or the payment itself waits for a reversal or is reversed.

A second person approves the reversal of the allocation, and that reverses it (BR-305, BR-603, BR-606): the
amount is unapplied again, the bill is owed it again and its status moves back, and the ledger gets the mirror
pair, in one transaction. The cashier who asked cannot approve: 403. The body may be left out.
A second person rejects the reversal of the allocation, saying why (BR-605): the allocation is in force again, as it was.

Allocates the payment to one or more posted bills of its payer, all of them or none (BR-303, BR-304). Each
bill's balance due and status follow (BR-208). 422 when an amount is more than the payment has unapplied or
the bill is owed, the bill is not posted, or it is owed by another payer. Needs If-Match, with the version
of the payment, and an Idempotency-Key.

post.summary: Voids a draft, with a reason. The refund keeps its content and can no longer change. Needs If-Match.

The maker asks for the draft to be posted (BR-604). Every refund needs a second person, so this never posts: it
answers 202 with the refund in `PendingApproval`, without a number and without any ledger effect. 422 when
its date is no longer allowed or its amount is more than the source has left (BR-307); 409 when the payment
waits for its reversal or was reversed. Needs If-Match and an Idempotency-Key; no body.

A second person approves a refund that waits, and that posts it (BR-307, BR-603, BR-606): the number, the
source lowered by the amount, the ledger entry and the audit records, in one transaction. The maker cannot
approve their own refund: 403. The cap and the payer are asked again (BR-307, BR-309). Needs If-Match and an
Idempotency-Key; the body, an optional comment, may be left out.

A second person rejects a refund that waits, saying why (BR-605): it is a draft again and can be corrected
and submitted once more. Needs If-Match and an Idempotency-Key.

put.summary:
Replaces every line of a draft with the lines sent and recomputes the totals (BR-202, BR-203). Needs If-Match,
with the version of the bill.

post.summary: Voids a draft, with a reason (US-23). The bill keeps its content and can no longer change. Needs If-Match.

Posts a draft (US-21, BR-206): the bill gets the next number of the fiscal year of its bill date, the payer owes
its total, and it can no longer be edited or voided. All of it, with the ledger entry and the audit record, is
one transaction (BR-007). A bill at or above the approval threshold of the hospital is not posted: it answers
202 and waits for a second person (BR-207). Needs If-Match and an Idempotency-Key; no body.

A second person approves a bill that waits for approval, and that posts it (US-22; BR-603, BR-606): the number,
the ledger entry and the audit records, in one transaction. The maker cannot approve their own bill: 403.
Needs If-Match and an Idempotency-Key; the body, an optional comment, may be left out.

A second person rejects a bill that waits for approval, saying why (BR-605): the bill is a draft again and can
be corrected and posted once more. Needs If-Match and an Idempotency-Key.

A cashier asks for one application of the credit note to be reversed. 202: the application waits in
`PendingReversal`, still applied to its bill. 404 when the credit note has no such application; 409 when
it already waits or is reversed; 422 when it is the application made at posting.

A second person approves the reversal of the application, and that reverses it (ADR 0028; BR-603, BR-606): the
amount is available credit again, the bill is owed it again and its status moves back, and the ledger gets the
mirror pair, in one transaction. The cashier who asked cannot approve: 403. The body may be left out.
A second person rejects the reversal of the application, saying why (BR-605): the application is in force again, as it was.

The maker asks for the draft to be posted (US-24; BR-212, BR-604). Every credit note needs a second person, so
this never posts: it answers 202 with the credit note in `PendingApproval`, without a number and without
any ledger effect. 422 when the credit note has no line or comes to nothing, its date is no longer allowed, or
the credits of the bill or of one of its lines would exceed it (BR-210, BR-211). Needs If-Match and an
Idempotency-Key; no body.

A second person approves a credit note that waits, and that posts it (US-24; BR-212, BR-603, BR-606): the
number, the ledger entries, the credit applied to its bill as far as the bill is owed, and the audit records,
in one transaction. The maker cannot approve their own credit note: 403. Needs If-Match and an
Idempotency-Key; the body, an optional comment, may be left out.

A second person rejects a credit note that waits, saying why (BR-605): it is a draft again and can be corrected
and submitted once more. Needs If-Match and an Idempotency-Key.

Applies available credit of a posted credit note to one or more posted bills of its payer, all of them or none
(BR-213). Each bill's balance due and status follow (BR-208). 422 when an amount is more than the credit note
has available or the bill is owed, the bill is not posted, or it is owed by another payer. Needs If-Match,
with the version of the credit note, and an Idempotency-Key.

without a number and without any ledger effect. 422 when its date is no longer allowed or its amount is more
than the bill is owed (BR-501). Needs If-Match and an Idempotency-Key; no body.

bill lowered by the amount, the ledger entry and the audit records, in one transaction. The maker cannot
approve their own adjustment: 403. Needs If-Match and an Idempotency-Key; the body, an optional comment, may be
left out.

and submitted once more. Needs If-Match and an Idempotency-Key.

AdjustmentDto.description:
An adjustment as the API returns it. string AdjustmentDto.Version is the row version in base64, the value of the ETag; a
change sends it back in If-Match (BR-804).

AdjustmentKind.description:
Why a bill is lowered without money or a credit note (BR-501). The member names are stored as text
(docs/database.md, section 3.5), so renaming one is a data migration.

AdjustmentStatus.description:
Where an adjustment is in its life (docs/domain-model.md, section 4.8). The member names are stored as text, so
renaming one is a data migration.

AgeingBucketDto.description:
One bucket of the ageing: its name (`0-30`, `31-60`, `61-90`, `90+`), the bills in it, what they
owe, and that in percent of everything owed (two places; the shares may add up to 99.99 or 100.01).

AgeingDto.description:
The ageing as of a day: the four buckets, always all four, and their total, which is the outstanding dues of that day
(the Receivable account, BR-404).

allocations.description: Between 1 and 50 allocations; a bill is named once.

AllocatePaymentRequest.description:
The body of `POST /api/v1/payments/{id}/allocations` (BR-303): the bills and the amount for each. Unknown
members are refused.

billId.description: A posted bill of the payer the payment came from. Required.

amount.description:
The amount to apply, above zero, with at most two decimals; not more than the payment has unapplied or the
bill is owed. Required.

AllocationRequest.description: One line of an allocation request: an amount of the payment for one bill. Unknown members are refused.

applications.description: Between 1 and 50 applications; a bill is named once.

ApplyCreditNoteRequest.description: The body of `POST /api/v1/credit-notes/{id}/applications` (BR-213): the bills and the amount for each. Unknown members are refused.

ApprovalAction.description: What the maker asks to be done to the document, once a checker approves (BR-604, BR-606).

ApprovalDocumentType.description: The kind of document an approval request is about (BR-604; docs/database.md, section 3.6).

ApprovalRequestDto.description: An approval request as the API returns it: who asked for what on which document, and who decided.

ApprovalStatus.description: Where an approval request stands (docs/domain-model.md, section 5.4). A decision is final.

comment.description: What the checker has to say, at most 500 characters.

ApproveAdjustmentRequest.description: The body of `POST /api/v1/adjustments/{id}/approve`: an optional comment of the checker. The body itself may be left out.

comment.description: What the checker has to say, at most 500 characters.

ApproveBillRequest.description: The body of `POST /api/v1/bills/{id}/approve`: an optional comment of the checker. The body itself may be left out.

comment.description: What the checker has to say, at most 500 characters.

ApproveCreditApplicationReversalRequest.description: The body of an approval of the reversal of an application of credit: an optional comment. The body itself may be left out.

comment.description: What the checker has to say, at most 500 characters.

ApproveCreditNoteRequest.description: The body of `POST /api/v1/credit-notes/{id}/approve`: an optional comment of the checker. The body itself may be left out.

ApprovePrefixChangeRequest.description: The optional body of `POST /api/v1/settings/prefix-changes/{id}/approve`: a comment. Unknown members are refused.

comment.description: What the checker has to say, at most 500 characters.

ApproveRefundRequest.description: The body of `POST /api/v1/refunds/{id}/approve`: an optional comment of the checker. The body itself may be left out.

comment.description: What the checker has to say, at most 500 characters.

ApproveReversalRequest.description: The body of an approval of a reversal: an optional comment of the checker. The body itself may be left out.

id.description: The number of the entry; entries of one trail are in the order of their numbers.

occurredAtUtc.description: When the change happened, in UTC.

userId.description: Who made the change; null for system work.

correlationId.description: The correlation id of the request that made the change (BR-703).

entityType.description: The kind of record that changed.

entityId.description: The id of the record that changed.

documentNumber.description: The number of the document, when it has one.

oneOf.description: The record before the change; null when the change created it.

reason.description: The reason a person gave, when the change needed one.

AuditRecordDto.description:
One entry of an audit trail, as the API returns it. JsonElement? AuditRecordDto.Before and JsonElement AuditRecordDto.After are the record
that changed, as JSON objects whose members are the stored columns; a bill carries its lines.

AvailableCreditNoteDto.description: A posted credit note that still holds credit not applied or refunded (BR-213).

AvailableCreditTotalsDto.description: Every credit note of the report together; decimal AvailableCreditTotalsDto.AvailableAmount equals the balance of the CreditAvailable account (BR-901).

BillDto.description:
A bill as the API returns it, with its lines in the order of their numbers. The totals are the sums of the lines
(BR-203). string BillDto.Version is the row version in base64, the same value the response carries in its ETag
header; a change sends it back in If-Match (BR-804, ADR 0007). It changes whenever the bill or any of its lines does.

BillLineDto.description:
One line of a bill as the API returns it (BR-201, BR-202). The id is what a credit note line names when it credits
this line (BR-211). The quantity has up to three decimals, the unit price up
to four, the tax rate up to two; the three amounts are exact to the paisa.

serviceItemId.description: The catalogue entry the line is priced from; left out for a free-text line.

description.description: What is charged; when left out, the name of the service item.

quantity.description: How many units: more than 0, at most three decimals.

unitPrice.description: The price of one unit: 0 or more, at most four decimals; when left out, the item's default price.

discountAmount.description: The discount on the line: 0 or more, at most two decimals, not more than the line amount; 0 when left out.

taxRatePercent.description: The tax rate in percent: 0 to 100, at most two decimals; when left out, the item's tax rate.

BillLineRequest.description:
One line of a bill in a request body (BR-201). With a `serviceItemId`, the description, the unit price and the
tax rate may be left out and are then taken from the catalogue; without one, all three are required. A member the
API does not know is refused with 400.

BillRegisterRowDto.description: One posted bill in the bill register.

BillRegisterTotalsDto.description:
The bill register's totals over the whole period and filter: how many bills, what they came to, and what is still
owed on them. decimal BillRegisterTotalsDto.Total equals the debits to Receivable of their postings (BR-901).

BillStatus.description:
Where a bill is in its life (docs/domain-model.md, section 5.1). Members are added at the end, so their order is the
order in which the slices arrived, not the order of the life of a bill. The member names are stored as text (docs/database.md, section 3.3), so renaming one is a
data migration.

BillSummaryDto.description: A bill as a list shows it: everything but its lines and its void details, which the bill itself returns.

currentPassword.description: The password the user has now.

newPassword.description: The password the user chooses: 12 to 128 characters, not the current one.

ChangePasswordRequest.description: The body of `POST /api/v1/auth/password`: the current password and the new one (ADR 0051).

CollectionByMethodDto.description:
One payment method on one business date: the payments received that day and what they came to, the payments of this
method reversed that day, the refunds paid this way that day, and what is left. decimal CollectionByMethodDto.Net is
decimal CollectionByMethodDto.Received less decimal CollectionByMethodDto.Reversed and decimal CollectionByMethodDto.Refunded.

CollectionTotalsDto.description:
Every method of one business date together. decimal CollectionTotalsDto.Net equals the movement of the Cash account in the ledger on
that date: its debits less its credits (BR-901).

billId.description: The posted bill the adjustment lowers. Cannot be changed later.

adjustmentDate.description: The business date of the adjustment; today in India when left out. Not before the bill date.

amount.description: By how much the bill is lowered: above zero, at most two decimals; less than 1.00 for a rounding. Required.

reason.description: Why the bill is lowered. Required.

CreateAdjustmentRequest.description: The body of `POST /api/v1/adjustments`: a draft adjustment against a posted bill (BR-501). Unknown members are refused.

patientId.description: The patient the bill is for. Cannot be changed later.

payerId.description: The payer who owes the bill. Cannot be changed later.

billDate.description: The business date of the bill; today in India when left out (BR-205).

dueDate.description: The date the bill is due; the bill date plus the hospital's default due days when left out (BR-205).

encounterReference.description: The visit or admission the bill is for.

notes.description: A note for whoever reads the bill.

lines.description: The lines, in the order they appear on the bill; may be left out and added later.

CreateBillRequest.description:
The body of `POST /api/v1/bills`: a draft bill. A member the API does not know is refused with 400, so a
misspelt field cannot pass unnoticed.

billId.description: The posted bill the credit note is against. Cannot be changed later.

creditNoteDate.description: The business date of the credit note; today in India when left out. Not before the bill date (BR-214).

reason.description: Why the credit is given. Required.

lines.description: The lines, in the order they appear on the credit note; may be left out and added later.

CreateCreditNoteRequest.description: The body of `POST /api/v1/credit-notes`: a draft credit note against a posted bill. Unknown members are refused.

oneOf.description: SelfPay. Insurer and Corporate are reserved for R4 and refused with 422 (BR-103).

patientId.description: The patient the payer is; left out for a guarantor (BR-104).

CreatePayerRequest.description:
The body of `POST /api/v1/payers`. A member the API does not know is refused with 400, so a misspelt field
cannot pass unnoticed.

paymentId.description: The payment whose unapplied cash is paid back. Give this or Guid? CreateRefundRequest.CreditNoteId, not both.

creditNoteId.description: The credit note whose available credit is paid back. Give this or Guid? CreateRefundRequest.PaymentId, not both.

refundDate.description: `yyyy-MM-dd`; today in India when left out.

amount.description: Above zero, at most two decimals.

reference.description: The UPI id, card authorisation, UTR or cheque number of the payout; required unless the method is cash.

reason.description: Why the money is paid back, at most 500 characters.

CreateRefundRequest.description: The body of `POST /api/v1/refunds`: one source, the amount and how it is paid back. Unknown members are refused.

code.description: The code of the item, unique in the tenant: letters, digits and `. - _ /`. It cannot be changed later.

name.description: The name of the service, as a bill line shows it.

category.description: A free grouping for lists and reports.

defaultUnitPrice.description: The price of one unit that a new bill line starts from: 0 or more, at most four decimals.

taxRatePercent.description: The tax rate, in percent, that a new bill line starts from: 0 to 100, at most two decimals.

CreateServiceItemRequest.description:
The body of `POST /api/v1/service-items`. A member the API does not know is refused with 400, so a misspelt
field cannot pass unnoticed.

email.description: The e-mail address, unique in the tenant without regard to case; at most 256 characters.

displayName.description: The name shown for the user; at most 200 characters.

CreateUserRequest.description: The body of `POST /api/v1/users`. Unknown members are refused.

billId.description: A posted bill of the payer the credit note belongs to. Required.

amount.description: The amount to apply, above zero, with at most two decimals. Required.

CreditApplicationRequest.description: One line of a request to apply credit: an amount of the credit note for one bill. Unknown members are refused.

CreditNoteAllocationStatus.description:
Where the application of a credit note to a bill is in its life (docs/domain-model.md, section 4.5). Members are
added at the end; their names are stored as text, so renaming one is a data migration.

CreditNoteDto.description:
A credit note as the API returns it, with its lines in the order of their numbers and the applications of its
credit, the oldest first. decimal CreditNoteDto.AvailableAmount is the credit not applied yet (BR-213).
string CreditNoteDto.Version is the row version in base64, the value of the ETag; a change sends it back in If-Match
(BR-804).

CreditNoteLineDto.description:
One line of a credit note as the API returns it (BR-202, BR-211). `BillLineId` is the line of the bill it
credits, null when it credits the bill as a whole.

billLineId.description: The line of the bill this line credits (the `id` of the line in the bill); left out for a line that credits the bill as a whole.

description.description: What is credited; when left out, the description of the bill line.

quantity.description: How many units: more than 0, at most three decimals.

unitPrice.description: The price of one unit: 0 or more, at most four decimals; when left out, the unit price of the bill line.

discountAmount.description: The discount on the line: 0 or more, at most two decimals, not more than the line amount; 0 when left out.

taxRatePercent.description: The tax rate in percent: 0 to 100, at most two decimals; when left out, the tax rate of the bill line.

CreditNoteLineRequest.description:
One line of a credit note in a request body (BR-211). With a `billLineId`, the description, the unit price and
the tax rate may be left out and are then taken from that line of the bill; without one, all three are required.
A member the API does not know is refused with 400.

CreditNoteStatus.description:
Where a credit note is in its life (docs/domain-model.md, section 4.5). The member names are stored as text
(docs/database.md, section 3.3), so renaming one is a data migration.

CreditNoteSummaryDto.description: A credit note as a list shows it: everything but its lines, its applications and its void details.

DailyCollectionDto.description: The collection of one business date: a row for every payment method, zeros included, and the totals.

DailyFiguresDto.description:
One business date of the dashboard, the points of the cards' sparklines (BR-902): what was billed and collected that
day, and at the end of the day what was owed on bills, what money was held unapplied, and how many requests waited.

DashboardSummaryDto.description:
The summary of the dashboard (US-44, BR-902): the period and the previous one, and six cards. Billed and collected are
the sums of each period; outstanding dues, unapplied cash and pending approvals are those at the end of each period's
last day; reconciliation drift is the count of now, with no previous figure.

DashboardTrendDto.description:
The trend of the dashboard: the period, the interval of its points, billed against collected per point, and the figures
of every day of the period for the cards' sparklines.

DocumentPrefixesDto.description: The default number prefix of each document type (BR-802): the prefix of its next new series.

DocumentType.description:
The kinds of document that are numbered (BR-801): each has its own gapless series per tenant and fiscal year, and
its own default prefix among the tenant's settings (BR-802). The member names are stored as text
(docs/database.md, section 3.6), so renaming one is a data migration.

DriftCountDto.description: How many drift rows one broken identity has.

DriftRowDto.description:
One drift row of the reconciliation: which identity is broken (the names of docs/database.md section 5.6), the bill,
payment, credit note, payer, posting or number series it is about, its document number or other reference where it
has one, and the two figures that disagree: what is cached (or counted) and what the ledger (or the series) says.

tenant.description: The code of the tenant (the hospital), in any case.

email.description: The e-mail address of the user, in any case.

LoginRequest.description: The body of `POST /api/v1/auth/login`: the hospital's code, the e-mail address and the password. Unknown members are refused.

OutstandingTotalsDto.description: Every payer of the report together: how many, and the sums of their balances, each equal to its ledger account.

PageOfOfAdjustmentDto.description:
One page of a list (docs/api.md): the items in a stable order, the number of the page (from 1), the page size that
was asked for, and how many items all pages hold together.

PageOfOfApprovalRequestDto.description:
One page of a list (docs/api.md): the items in a stable order, the number of the page (from 1), the page size that
was asked for, and how many items all pages hold together.

PageOfOfAuditRecordDto.description:
One page of a list (docs/api.md): the items in a stable order, the number of the page (from 1), the page size that
was asked for, and how many items all pages hold together.

PageOfOfBillSummaryDto.description:
One page of a list (docs/api.md): the items in a stable order, the number of the page (from 1), the page size that
was asked for, and how many items all pages hold together.

PageOfOfCreditNoteSummaryDto.description:
One page of a list (docs/api.md): the items in a stable order, the number of the page (from 1), the page size that
was asked for, and how many items all pages hold together.

PageOfOfPatientDto.description:
One page of a list (docs/api.md): the items in a stable order, the number of the page (from 1), the page size that
was asked for, and how many items all pages hold together.

PageOfOfPayerDto.description:
One page of a list (docs/api.md): the items in a stable order, the number of the page (from 1), the page size that
was asked for, and how many items all pages hold together.

PageOfOfPaymentDto.description:
One page of a list (docs/api.md): the items in a stable order, the number of the page (from 1), the page size that
was asked for, and how many items all pages hold together.

PageOfOfPrefixChangeDto.description:
One page of a list (docs/api.md): the items in a stable order, the number of the page (from 1), the page size that
was asked for, and how many items all pages hold together.

PageOfOfRefundDto.description:
One page of a list (docs/api.md): the items in a stable order, the number of the page (from 1), the page size that
was asked for, and how many items all pages hold together.

PageOfOfServiceItemDto.description:
One page of a list (docs/api.md): the items in a stable order, the number of the page (from 1), the page size that
was asked for, and how many items all pages hold together.

PageOfOfUserDto.description:
One page of a list (docs/api.md): the items in a stable order, the number of the page (from 1), the page size that
was asked for, and how many items all pages hold together.

PatientDto.description:
A patient as the API returns it. string PatientDto.Version is the row version in base64, the same value the response
carries in its ETag header; a change sends it back in If-Match (BR-804, ADR 0007).

PatientStatus.description:
Whether a patient can be billed (BR-102). The member names are stored as text (docs/database.md, section 3.2), so
renaming one is a data migration.

PayerDto.description:
A payer as the API returns it. Guid? PayerDto.PatientId is the patient the payer is, or null for a guarantor.
string PayerDto.Version is the row version in base64, the same value the response carries in its ETag header; a change
sends it back in If-Match (BR-804, ADR 0007).

PayerKind.description:
Who a payer is (BR-103). Only PayerKind.SelfPay exists in R1; the other two members are reserved for R4 so that
the API can name them, and creating such a payer is refused. The member names are stored as text, so renaming one is
a data migration.

PayerOutstandingDto.description:
What a payer owes and what is held for them (US-40, BR-404): the balances due of their posted bills, the money they paid
that is not applied to a bill, the credit of their credit notes not yet used, and what they owe net of the two.
Each equals the sum of the payer's entries in its ledger account (docs/database.md section 5.5, identities 6 to 8).

PayerStatus.description:
Whether a payer can take on new business (BR-105). The member names are stored as text (docs/database.md, section
3.2), so renaming one is a data migration.

PaymentAllocationDto.description:
One allocation of a payment to a bill, as the API returns it. `ReversedAtUtc` and `ReversalReason` are
            null unless the allocation was reversed (BR-305).

PaymentAllocationsDto.description:
A payment with every allocation made from it, the oldest first: what an allocation request answers and what
`GET /payments/{id}/allocations` returns. The version of the payment is the ETag.

PaymentAllocationStatus.description:
Where an allocation is in its life (docs/domain-model.md, section 5.3). Members are added at the end; their names
are stored as text, so renaming one is a data migration.

PaymentDto.description:
A payment as the API returns it. `ReversedAtUtc` and `ReversalReason` are null unless the payment was
            reversed (BR-306). `Version` is the row version, sent back as the ETag (BR-804).

PaymentMethod.description: How money was received (BR-301). The member names are stored as text, so renaming one is a data migration.

PaymentRegisterRowDto.description: One payment in the payment register.

PaymentRegisterTotalsDto.description:
The payment register's totals over the whole period and filter: how many payments, what they brought in, and what of
it is not applied to a bill. decimal PaymentRegisterTotalsDto.Amount equals the debits to Cash of their postings (BR-901).

PaymentStatus.description:
Where a payment is in its life (docs/domain-model.md, section 5.3). A payment is posted the moment it is recorded
(BR-302), so there is no draft. Members are added at the end; their names are stored as text, so renaming one is a
data migration.

PendingApprovalDto.description:
A maker-checker request that waits for a decision (BR-604, BR-901): what it asks, of which document, by whom, with what
comment and since when, how many days that is in India, and the document's payer and amount where it has them. A prefix
change has neither. The reversal of an allocation or of an application of credit names the payment or the credit note
it belongs to, through which it is decided (ADR 0042 point 2).

PendingApprovalsTotalsDto.description: Every waiting request of the report together: how many, and since when the oldest has waited.

PrefixChangeDto.description: A prefix change (docs/api.md section 8.14): which type, from which prefix to which, where it stands, and who asked when.

ReconciliationTotalsDto.description:
The whole reconciliation: when it was run, how many drift rows it found (zero when the caches equal the ledger and
every series is gapless), and how many for each broken identity.

payerId.description: The payer the money came from. Required.

paymentDate.description: The date the money was received, `yyyy-MM-dd`; today in India when left out.

oneOf.description: Cash, Card, UPI, BankTransfer or Cheque. Required.

reference.description: The UPI id, card authorisation, UTR or cheque number; required unless the method is Cash.

amount.description: The amount received, above zero, with at most two decimals. Required.

RecordPaymentRequest.description: The body of `POST /api/v1/payments` (BR-301). Unknown members are refused.

RefundDto.description: A refund as the API answers it (docs/api.md, section 8.10). Exactly one of the two source ids is set.

RefundSourceKind.description: Where the money of a refund comes from (BR-307). The member names are stored as text, so renaming one is a data migration.

RefundStatus.description: Where a refund is in its life (docs/domain-model.md, section 5.2). The member names are stored as text.

mrn.description: The MRN from the hospital's HIS (BR-101).

oneOf.description: The recorded sex: Male, Female, Other or Unknown.

addressLine1.description: The first line of the address.

addressLine2.description: The second line of the address.

RegisterPatientRequest.description:
The body of `POST /api/v1/patients`. Every member may be missing from the JSON; the validator of the use case
says which are required. A member the API does not know is refused with 400, so a misspelt field cannot pass
unnoticed.

comment.description: The reason. Required; the maker reads it.

RejectAdjustmentRequest.description: The body of `POST /api/v1/adjustments/{id}/reject`: why the checker rejects (BR-605). Unknown members are refused.

comment.description: The reason, required, at most 500 characters.

RejectBillRequest.description: The body of `POST /api/v1/bills/{id}/reject`: why the checker rejects (BR-605).

comment.description: The reason. Required; the cashier reads it.

RejectCreditApplicationReversalRequest.description: The body of a rejection of the reversal of an application of credit: why the checker rejects (BR-605). Unknown members are refused.

comment.description: The reason. Required; the maker reads it.

RejectCreditNoteRequest.description: The body of `POST /api/v1/credit-notes/{id}/reject`: why the checker rejects (BR-605). Unknown members are refused.

RejectPrefixChangeRequest.description: The body of `POST /api/v1/settings/prefix-changes/{id}/reject`: why, which is required. Unknown members are refused.

comment.description: The reason. Required; the maker reads it.

RejectRefundRequest.description: The body of `POST /api/v1/refunds/{id}/reject`: why the checker rejects (BR-605). Unknown members are refused.

comment.description: The reason. Required; the cashier reads it.

RejectReversalRequest.description: The body of a rejection of a reversal: why the checker rejects (BR-605). Unknown members are refused.

lines.description: The lines, in the order they appear on the bill.

ReplaceBillLinesRequest.description:
The body of `PUT /api/v1/bills/{id}/lines`: every line the draft is to have, in order. The lines it had are
replaced; an empty list removes them all. A member the API does not know is refused with 400.

lines.description: The lines, in the order they appear on the credit note.

ReplaceCreditNoteLinesRequest.description: The body of `PUT /api/v1/credit-notes/{id}/lines`: every line the draft is to have, in order. Unknown members are refused.

ReplaceUserRolesRequest.description: The body of `PUT /api/v1/users/{id}/roles`: every role the user is to hold. Unknown members are refused.

ReportBillStatus.description:
The state of a bill in the bill register: one of the states of a posted bill (BR-208). Reporting's own word for it,
since it may not name the Billing module's enum (ADR 0036); the names are the same, and a test keeps them so.

ReportPageOfAvailableCreditNoteDtoAndAva.description:
One page of a report (docs/api.md section 8.15): the items of the page in a stable order, the paging of a list, and
the totals of every page together, so that a report can be held against the ledger (BR-901, ADR 0036). A register
also says which period it covers; the other reports have none.

ReportPageOfBillRegisterRowDtoAndBillReg.description:
One page of a report (docs/api.md section 8.15): the items of the page in a stable order, the paging of a list, and
the totals of every page together, so that a report can be held against the ledger (BR-901, ADR 0036). A register
also says which period it covers; the other reports have none.

ReportPageOfDriftRowDtoAndReconciliation.description:
One page of a report (docs/api.md section 8.15): the items of the page in a stable order, the paging of a list, and
the totals of every page together, so that a report can be held against the ledger (BR-901, ADR 0036). A register
also says which period it covers; the other reports have none.

ReportPageOfPayerOutstandingDtoAndOutsta.description:
One page of a report (docs/api.md section 8.15): the items of the page in a stable order, the paging of a list, and
the totals of every page together, so that a report can be held against the ledger (BR-901, ADR 0036). A register
also says which period it covers; the other reports have none.

ReportPageOfPaymentRegisterRowDtoAndPaym.description:
One page of a report (docs/api.md section 8.15): the items of the page in a stable order, the paging of a list, and
the totals of every page together, so that a report can be held against the ledger (BR-901, ADR 0036). A register
also says which period it covers; the other reports have none.

ReportPageOfPendingApprovalDtoAndPending.description:
One page of a report (docs/api.md section 8.15): the items of the page in a stable order, the paging of a list, and
the totals of every page together, so that a report can be held against the ledger (BR-901, ADR 0036). A register
also says which period it covers; the other reports have none.

ReportPageOfUnappliedPaymentDtoAndUnappl.description:
One page of a report (docs/api.md section 8.15): the items of the page in a stable order, the paging of a list, and
the totals of every page together, so that a report can be held against the ledger (BR-901, ADR 0036). A register
also says which period it covers; the other reports have none.

ReportPaymentMethod.description:
How money was received or paid back, in a report. Reporting's own word for it, since it may not name the Payments
module's enum (ADR 0036); the names are the same, and a test keeps them so.

ReportPaymentStatus.description:
The state of a payment in a report. Reporting's own word for it, since it may not name the Payments module's enum
(ADR 0036); the names are the same, and a test keeps them so.

ReportPeriodDto.description: The business dates a report covers, both included: calendar dates in India (BR-003).

comment.description: A word for the checker, at most 500 characters.

RequestPrefixChangeRequest.description: The body of `POST /api/v1/settings/prefix-changes`: the document type, its new prefix and an optional comment. Unknown members are refused.

reason.description: The reason, at most 500 characters. Required; the checker reads it, and it is kept with the reversal.

RequestReversalRequest.description:
The body of a request to reverse a payment or one of its allocations: why (BR-305, BR-306). Unknown members are
refused.

ResetUserPasswordRequest.description: The body of `POST /api/v1/users/{id}/password`: the new password. Unknown members are refused.

reason.description: The reason, at most 500 characters. Required; the checker reads it, and it is kept with the reversal.

ReverseCreditApplicationRequest.description: The body of a request to reverse an application of credit: why (ADR 0028). Unknown members are refused.

Role.description:
What a user may do in a tenant (BR-601; docs/requirements.md section 1). A user holds one or more. The member names
are stored as text and are the codes of the `Roles` table, so renaming one is a data migration.

ServiceItemDto.description:
A service item as the API returns it. decimal ServiceItemDto.DefaultUnitPrice has up to four decimals and
decimal ServiceItemDto.TaxRatePercent up to two. string ServiceItemDto.Version is the row version in base64, the same value the
response carries in its ETag header; a change sends it back in If-Match (BR-804, ADR 0007).

ServiceItemStatus.description:
Whether an entry of the service catalogue can be put on new bill lines. The member names are stored as text
(docs/database.md, section 3.3), so renaming one is a data migration.

SignedInDto.description: What a successful sign-in answers (docs/api.md, section 8.12): the token, its type, and when it expires.

SummaryFigureDto.description:
One card of the dashboard: its figure for the period, the same figure for the previous period, and the change in
percent (BR-902). decimal? SummaryFigureDto.ChangePercent is null when the previous figure is zero, and both are null for a figure
that has no history (reconciliation drift).

version.description: Informational version of the API assembly.

TenantSettingsDto.description:
The settings of the tenant (BR-607; docs/api.md section 8.13): the approval threshold (null for none), the back-date
window and the default due days, the default prefix of each document type, and the tenant's version.

TrendInterval.description: The steps of the dashboard's trend: business dates, or weeks from Monday to Sunday.

TrendPointDto.description:
One step of the trend, a day or a week, DateOnly TrendPointDto.From to DateOnly TrendPointDto.To: what was billed and collected in it,
and since the period's start up to its end.

UnappliedCashTotalsDto.description: Every payment of the report together; decimal UnappliedCashTotalsDto.UnappliedAmount equals the balance of the UnappliedCash account (BR-901).

UnappliedPaymentDto.description: A payment that still holds money not applied to a bill (BR-304).

adjustmentDate.description: The business date of the adjustment. Required.

amount.description: By how much the bill is lowered. Required.

reason.description: Why the bill is lowered. Required.

UpdateAdjustmentRequest.description: The body of `PUT /api/v1/adjustments/{id}`: everything a draft adjustment says, replaced as a whole. Unknown members are refused.

billDate.description: The business date of the bill. Required.

dueDate.description: The date the bill is due, not before the bill date. Required.

encounterReference.description: The visit or admission the bill is for.

notes.description: A note for whoever reads the bill.

UpdateBillHeaderRequest.description:
The body of `PATCH /api/v1/bills/{id}`: both dates and the two texts of a draft, and a text left out is
cleared. The patient, the payer, the status and the lines cannot be changed here: a body that names them, or any
member the API does not know, is refused with 400.

creditNoteDate.description: The business date of the credit note. Required.

reason.description: Why the credit is given. Required.

UpdateCreditNoteHeaderRequest.description: The body of `PATCH /api/v1/credit-notes/{id}`: the date and the reason of a draft. Unknown members are refused.

oneOf.description: The recorded sex: Male, Female, Other or Unknown.

addressLine1.description: The first line of the address.

addressLine2.description: The second line of the address.

UpdatePatientRequest.description:
The body of `PATCH /api/v1/patients/{id}`: the complete demographics, every member sent, and an optional one
left out is cleared. The MRN and the status cannot be changed here: a body that names them, or any member the API
does not know, is refused with 400.

UpdatePayerRequest.description:
The body of `PATCH /api/v1/payers/{id}`: the name and every contact detail, and a contact detail left out is
cleared. The kind, the patient link and the status cannot be changed here: a body that names them, or any member the
API does not know, is refused with 400.

amount.description: Above zero, at most two decimals. Required.

oneOf.description: How the money is paid back. Required.

reference.description: The reference of the payout; required unless the method is cash.

UpdateRefundRequest.description: The body of `PUT /api/v1/refunds/{id}`: every value of the draft again; the source cannot change. Unknown members are refused.

name.description: The name of the service, as a bill line shows it.

category.description: A free grouping for lists and reports.

defaultUnitPrice.description: The price of one unit that a new bill line starts from: 0 or more, at most four decimals.

taxRatePercent.description: The tax rate, in percent, that a new bill line starts from: 0 to 100, at most two decimals.

UpdateServiceItemRequest.description:
The body of `PATCH /api/v1/service-items/{id}`: the name, the price, the tax rate and the category, and a
category left out is cleared. The code and the status cannot be changed here: a body that names them, or any member
the API does not know, is refused with 400.

postingApprovalThreshold.description: A bill whose total reaches this needs a second person (BR-207); none when left out or null.

maxBackdateDays.description: How many days before today a business date may lie, 0 to 365 (BR-205).

defaultDueDays.description: Days from the bill date to its default due date, 0 to 365 (BR-205).

UpdateSettingsRequest.description:
The body of `PATCH /api/v1/settings`: every setting it changes, as the new state (docs/api.md section 5). A
threshold left out or null means none. The prefixes are not here: they change through a prefix change. Unknown
members are refused.

UpdateUserRequest.description: The body of `PATCH /api/v1/users/{id}`: both values, given again. Unknown members are refused.

UserDto.description: A user as the API answers it (docs/api.md, section 8.11): never the password or its hash.

UserStatus.description: Whether a user may sign in (BR-601). The member names are stored as text.

reason.description: The reason. Required; it is kept with the adjustment.

VoidAdjustmentRequest.description: The body of `POST /api/v1/adjustments/{id}/void`: why the draft is voided. Unknown members are refused.

reason.description: The reason. Required; it is kept with the bill.

VoidBillRequest.description: The body of `POST /api/v1/bills/{id}/void`: why the draft is voided (US-23). A member the API does not know is refused with 400.

reason.description: The reason. Required; it is kept with the credit note.

VoidCreditNoteRequest.description: The body of `POST /api/v1/credit-notes/{id}/void`: why the draft is voided. Unknown members are refused.

reason.description: The reason, at most 500 characters. Required.

VoidRefundRequest.description: The body of `POST /api/v1/refunds/{id}/void`: why the draft is given up. Unknown members are refused.
